_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
O wewe Mwana nkodi {player_id} na Nkodi za Batatu.
Kimpwanza kiaku ni '{symbol}'.
O lenda kubika kimpwanza kiaku na mbao ya 5 kwa 5, mpila mstari wa nne.
Mistari ikala ya ndunda, ya kati, to ya diagonal.
Tambulisa mpini waku na muundo wa '[4]' mpila kubika kisanduku 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mutindu ya kutinda kele mbote ve. Sadila "[cell]" kisika selile kele 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nambari ya seli isiyo halali: {cell}. Inabidi iwe kati ya 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Na kati ya baselile {cell}, kele ti muntu mosi.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Muntu ya kebula {player_id} me sala kitambi mosi ya kukonda mfunu.

game_action.placed: Mwana {player_id} anaweka alama yake ({symbol}) kwenye uwanja ({row}, {col}).
